rule.wobble: mean rank move of the cities in the top 10 of either the published or the replicate ranking, averaged over the 80 replicates
rule.verdict: fail if total wobble over the touched searches exceeds 1.10 x the reference's; all searches when nothing is touched

old_rule.reading: soft (ADR 0011): the >= 8-of-10 overlap in >= 80% of replicates, every persona
